name: Leopard shark
spear: OK; divers exempt from season/depth closure
notes: Federal groundfish. No take in 8 offshore Groundfish Exclusion Areas (§27.50). Has size limit and no fillet size specified: may NOT be filleted aboard or brought ashore as fillets (§27.65(c)). ID vs smoothhounds/soupfin.

name: Soupfin shark
spear: OK; divers exempt from season/depth closure
notes: Federal groundfish (§28.49). No take in Groundfish Exclusion Areas (§27.50). ID caution: smoothhounds (10 limit) and leopard shark (3, 36 in) look similar. Fillets need 1 in square skin patch.

name: Shortfin mako shark
notes: §28.42 gives 2 of each species (mako, thresher, blue). Highly migratory species (§1.49). Fillets need 1 in square skin patch. Dangerous to spear; longfin mako not separately regulated.

name: Thresher shark
notes: §28.42: 2 of each species (mako, thresher, blue). Common, pelagic and bigeye threshers are all HMS (§1.49); the section does not split them, so treat as 2 thresher. Fillets need 1 in square skin patch.

name: Blue shark
notes: §28.42: 2 of each species (mako, thresher, blue). Highly migratory species (§1.49). Fillets need 1 in square skin patch.

name: Sixgill shark
notes: §28.41: one of each species (sixgill, sevengill). Deep-water; rarely encountered by freedivers. Fillets need 1 in square skin patch.

name: Broadnose sevengill shark
notes: §28.41: one of each species (sixgill, sevengill). Fillets need 1 in square skin patch.

name: White shark
notes: If hooked/speared accidentally, release immediately; do not remove from water. FGC §5517 also bans using bait/chum to attract white sharks and chumming within 1 nm of shore/pier/jetty when a white shark is visible or known present. §28.95 excludes white shark from spear-legal sharks.

name: Bat ray
notes: No species-specific section; general limit §27.60(a). Rays are 'finfish' (§1.46). Not a federal groundfish (§28.49 skates list excludes rays). Fillets/wings need 1 in square skin patch.

name: Shovelnose guitarfish
notes: No species-specific section; general limit §27.60(a). Guitarfish are rays, not federally managed skates. Fillets need 1 in square skin patch.

name: Pacific angel shark
notes: No species-specific section; §28.49 states it does not apply to 'other species of ... sharks', so general limit §27.60(a) governs. Fillets need 1 in square skin patch.

name: Horn shark
notes: No species-specific section; general limit §27.60(a). Fillets need 1 in square skin patch.

name: Swell shark
notes: No species-specific section; general limit §27.60(a). Fillets need 1 in square skin patch.

name: Smoothhounds (gray/brown)
bag: 10 per species, part of 20 finfish total
notes: No species-specific section; general limit §27.60(a). ID CAUTION: soupfin shark (limit 1, §28.49) and leopard shark (3, 36 in) are similar - confirm dorsal fin position/tooth shape before shooting. Fillets need 1 in square skin patch.

name: Skates (big/CA/longnose)
bag: 10 per species, part of 20 finfish total
spear: OK; divers exempt from season/depth closure
notes: All skates are federal groundfish (§28.49, §1.91(a)(6)). No take in Groundfish Exclusion Areas (§27.50). Spear legal per §28.95. Fillets/wings need 1 in square skin patch.

name: Spiny dogfish
spear: OK; divers exempt from season/depth closure
notes: Federal groundfish (§28.49). No take in Groundfish Exclusion Areas (§27.50). Venomous dorsal spines. Fillets need 1 in square skin patch.
